input: Find out if my employer offers tuition reimbursement

gold.taskTitle: Confirm Whether Employer Offers Tuition Reimbursement
gold.taskDescription: Investigate whether the user's current employer has a tuition reimbursement program and understand what it covers.

questions.title: What type of course or degree are you pursuing?
questions.description: Understand the academic goal the user wants reimbursement for.

questions.title: Have you already checked your employee handbook?
questions.description: Find out if the user has done any initial research into existing company documentation.

questions.title: Do you know who in HR to contact about benefits?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a specific HR contact or needs to identify one.

questions.title: Is your employer a large company or a small business?
questions.description: Gauge the likelihood of a formal reimbursement program existing based on company size.

questions.title: Do you need this information by a specific deadline?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a time constraint, such as an enrollment deadline.

questions.title: Are you a full-time or part-time employee there?
questions.description: Clarify employment status, as reimbursement eligibility often depends on it.

questions.title: Do you want to negotiate if no formal policy exists?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to explore requesting reimbursement even without a set program.
